title: Data and analysis code for: Warming, salinification, and food-web rewiring precede poleward expansion of a marsh ecosystem engineer

creators.name: Nelson, James A.
creators.affiliation: Department of Marine Sciences, University of Georgia

description: Analysis code, input data, EDI data-package manifests, and figure source data supporting the Scientific Reports manuscript on warming, salinification, and food-web rewiring preceding the poleward expansion of the mud fiddler crab (Minuca pugnax) at the Plum Island Ecosystems LTER. Version 1.1.0 adds the scripts and inputs that regenerate Figs 1-4, Supplementary Fig. 1 and Supplementary Tables 2 and 4 (burrow-density surveys, high-tide sonde extract, crab isotope values, mixing-model inputs and posterior summaries), with a check of the regenerated values against the archived figure source data.
